title: Developer check: a change made while the field is saving is ignored
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Pick sales rep B in the Sales Representative field.
  2. Before that save finishes, pick sales rep A.
  3. Before that save finishes, click the + button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field reads sales rep B while it saves.

Step 2:

  • The change made while the first was saving is ignored.

Step 3:

  • The + cannot be clicked until the save finishes.
  • Then the field shows what was saved (sales rep B).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-E1: “A change made while the previous change is still saving is ignored, and the + and remove x cannot be clicked until the save finishes. When it finishes, the field shows what was saved.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 1 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs a second click timed before a save finishes; check with developer tools or automation, not by hand
